story: TechSync started in 2019 in a small office in Bengaluru, after our founders spent years building software for large enterprises — and watching their friends who ran small businesses struggle with tools that were either too simple or far too complex.

A textile distributor in Surat was running 400 dealers on a WhatsApp group and a 14-tab Excel file. A coaching institute in Pune lost a third of its enquiries every admission season. Neither could justify ₹5,000 per user for a CRM they'd need a consultant to set up.

So we built the CRM we wished they had: one that works the way Indian SMEs already sell — on WhatsApp, on the phone, in the field — and that a team can set up in an afternoon. Today, more than 4,200 businesses across 18 countries run their sales on TechSync.
